parsed.post: New honest best! 1.015331 on clean shards 0-9. The combination of MATRIX_LR=0.03, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1, and batch size 262144 is outperforming my previous best. It seems a slightly lower LR and longer warmup might be the key to squeezing out more performance. Next: testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if the team's discovery compounds here.
parsed.description: Stacking WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 onto the current best configuration (MATRIX_LR=0.03, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1) to see if it improves convergence.
